crossRefs.note: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet…

parallels.note: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

translations.web: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
translations.bsb: He is to take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop to purify the house;
translations.kjv: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
translations.asv: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
